user.title: Connect Komoot
user.description: Sign in with your Komoot account. The integration uses Komoot's unofficial API and only reads your recorded tours. Accounts created only via Google or Apple need a password set at Komoot first.

reauth_confirm.title: Sign in to Komoot again
reauth_confirm.description: The password for {email} was rejected. Please enter the current password.

abort.already_configured: This Komoot account is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: That is a different Komoot account.

init.title: Filters and polling
init.description: The filters apply to the sensors. The map and statistics in the sidebar always show all tours and have their own filters.

data_description.name_filter: Optional, per sport: sport:text1|text2, more sports separated by comma. Example: other:Amazfit|Hiking counts tours of sport other only if the name contains one of the texts.

refresh.name: Refresh now
refresh.description: Fetches the tours from Komoot right away.

fetch_tracks.name: Load routes
fetch_tracks.description: Loads missing routes in the background.

force.name: Reload all
force.description: Also fetch routes that are already loaded.

get_statistics.name: Get statistics
get_statistics.description: Returns totals overall, per year, month and sport (all tours, independent of the sensor filters).

sport.name: Sports
sport.description: Keys such as hike or touringbicycle.
